answer: Require a 100-coin bond per paid job: a lagoon survey, a sonnet commission, or a kernel review. Cap each payout at 10 coins and audit a random 20% of deliveries against verifiable customer requirements; proven fabrication burns the bond. Draw audits only after submission so clones cannot select safe jobs. If audits reliably catch fabrication, a fake delivery has an expected 20-coin bond loss against at most 10 coins of revenue. More identities multiply this cost rather than escaping it.
